description: Handle FFmpeg unavailability gracefully in compose.ts - if ffmpeg is not installed or fails to spawn, return a clear error instead of crashing. Also fix the scene image download to handle empty imageUrl gracefully.
steps: In apps/web/src/lib/ugc/compose.ts, in the scene image download loop, skip scenes with empty or missing imageUrl and use the placeholder pattern: if a scene has an empty imageUrl, generate a simple 1080x1920 solid-color PNG file directly in the temp directory (just write raw PNG bytes to disk) instead of trying to download from an empty URL

In the runFfmpeg function, the 'error' event already handles spawn failures (ENOENT when ffmpeg binary not found) - verify this returns ok:false with the error message. The compose function already catches this and returns status:'failed'. This is acceptable behavior.
Add a brief console.warn when ffmpeg is not found to help users debug: 'FFmpeg not found. Install FFmpeg or set FFMPEG_PATH environment variable.'

Add a test in ffmpeg-compose.test.ts or compose.ts test that verifies a scene with empty imageUrl is handled (the buildUGCFfmpegArgs function should handle this case, OR document that upstream must never pass empty imageUrl - which we fixed in FEAT-002)
acceptance_criteria: Scenes with empty imageUrl do not crash the download loop in compose.ts
FFmpeg spawn failure returns a clear error message mentioning FFmpeg installation
The pipeline returns status:'failed' with a helpful error message if ffmpeg is unavailable (not an unhandled crash)
findings: Imported createSolidPNG from placeholder-image.ts to reuse the PNG generation logic. The compose test uses vi.hoisted() for the spawn mock. All 164 tests pass including 2 new tests. Typecheck clean.
